# Short #007 - Predictions from 1900 About the Year 2000

## Title options (1 = recommended)
1. In 1900, They Predicted Our World. Some Came True.
2. 28 Predictions From 1900 About Today
3. What People in 1900 Thought the Year 2000 Would Look Like

## Description
In December 1900, the Ladies' Home Journal published "What May Happen in the Next Hundred Years" by engineer John Elfreth Watkins Jr.: 28 predictions about the year 2000. Some missed (no C, X or Q in the alphabet, strawberries as large as apples, everybody walking ten miles a day). Others came true: photographs telegraphed from any distance, telephones around the world, ready-cooked meals bought from shops.

Visuals are AI-generated concept art, not photographs or historical footage.
